title: The binding read's docs say an unchanged binding keeps its obligation, but a waived one reopens at the next revision
outcome: The binding read's docs say an unchanged binding keeps its obligation, but a waived one reopens at the next revision
acceptance: A decision is recorded on whether an operator waiver should survive a revision that leaves the criterion and binding unchanged; if not, that behaviour change is filed and tested separately

The 'Reading what satisfied a bound criterion' section of acceptance-evaluation.md and the doc comment on AcceptanceBindingObligation.work_revision say that a revision keeps the older obligation for an unchanged binding unless it was waived, and that a waived one reopens at the next revision
